blind.description: A stylized medieval/fantasy feast table or low bench constructed of warm brown wood. It features two shaped trestle leg supports resting on dark brown block feet, joined by a central lower stretcher beam. The rectangular tabletop is bordered by a light beige draped cloth along the sides and capped with dark brown corner blocks, framing a rich red rectangular runner or inlaid inset on top.
blind.from_above: A clean rectangular shape featuring an elongated dark red center panel enclosed by a light tan border and four square dark brown corner pegs.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 40% as tall as the figure (approx. 2.2 to 2.5 ft tall), around as long as the figure is tall (approx. 5.5 to 6 ft long), and roughly 2 ft wide.
